title: Haoxiguan encrypted sync recovery envelope v1
description: The nine-field .hgr JSON envelope emitted by SyncRecoveryCodec. The 128 KiB raw-file limit, 64 KiB decrypted-plaintext limit, password rules, AAD and AEAD authentication remain runtime checks. This contains encrypted key material rather than habit data or authentication tokens.

payload.description: Canonical padded Base64 of 16..65552 ciphertext bytes including the 16-byte authentication tag. At the maximum encoded length padding is required, excluding the otherwise equal-length 65553-byte encoding. Decoding, decryption and keyring validation still occur at runtime.
